name: Accra College of Medicine
summary: A medical college in Accra with a six-year course: three years of preclinical sciences followed by three years of clinical sciences. Its undergraduate admissions page accepts the IB and explains the English proficiency evidence required from applicants whose first language is not English.

sources.title: ACM accepts the IB for Level 100 entry and publishes English proficiency requirements.
ACM’s six-year medical course has three preclinical and three clinical years.
